_comment: C0-13 midjourney bodies EN. 无附加小节。正文「相关条目」2 行带 .md 链接（stability-ai/flux），related 写 2 条（frontmatter related 是 [chatgpt]，related 键按正文链接行对齐=2）。sources 4 条对齐 frontmatter。

axes.model_access: Model iterations are disclosed via the official updates page (updates.midjourney.com) and the Alpha changelog (2026-10-08 "Testing Thinking Mode", 9-24 "Edit updates, thumbnail previews" and other entries, direct-fetched and verified 2026-10-21); versions are selectable at generation time, the default version follows the official docs.
axes.runtime: Two usage lines: the web app and the Discord bot; generation processed on Midjourney's cloud, no models run locally.
axes.local_files: Supports image uploads as reference and editing input; outputs are public and browsable in the community by default and can be remixed by others (official help-page framing); only the Pro/Mega tiers' Stealth mode promises best-effort non-publicity.
axes.background: Generation is task-based (submit-queue-output); no official statement of a "keep-running-after-shutdown" form.
axes.tools: The web editor keeps iterating (edit updates, thumbnail previews and other changelog entries); the Discord bot line can generate inside servers; the Remix mechanism is the product's built-in path for derivative creation.
axes.context: Generation is task-based, no cross-session memory form; personalization shows through parameters and Remix.
axes.permissions: Official privacy policy §1 explicitly applies to "data collected through the process of training Midjourney's machine-learning algorithms"; the official AB2013 training-data disclosure states the training set includes "data provided by third parties and Midjourney users"; public and remixable by default, Stealth mode (Pro/Mega) is the best-effort non-publicity option; no user-facing training opt-out switch found in official docs.
axes.fit: People who weight image style quality highly and can accept the "public by default" community form. If you need works kept private or clear commercial ownership, read the subscription tiers and Stealth clauses before starting; large-revenue companies should note the revenue-threshold clause.

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. Image generation does not fit the coding test protocol; capability claims follow the official changelog and docs.
unknowns:
- The current default model version and the full selectable-version list (disclosed entry by entry in the changelog; this site has not verified each version)
- The complete boundary of the personalization feature (follows the official docs)
